content: Google's own docs confirm skipping signature verification is acceptable only for the server-to-server token-exchange path (direct HTTPS call to oauth2.googleapis.com using the client secret) — but aud, iss, and exp MUST still be checked manually, and multi-client deployments must verify aud explicitly. email_verified must be checked separately; Google issues verified id_tokens for Workspace-managed accounts as always-verified but consumer Gmail accounts can have email_verified=false in edge cases, and non-Google IdPs federated through Google can pass through unverified emails.
